title: AWESOME Shop

fields.description: Redeem your FICSIT Coupons here!; For those employees going the extra kilometer we have set aside special bonus milestones and rewards! Get your Coupons in the AWESOME Sink program now!; *No refunds possible.

intro: The AWESOME Shop is a special building where generated from the AWESOME Sink can be spent to unlock blueprints or purchase parts for your factory. AWESOME is an acronym, which stands for "Anti-Waste Effort for Stress-Testing of Materials on Exoplanets".

title: AWESOME Sink

fields.description: Got excess resources? Fear not, for FICSIT does not waste! The newly developed AWESOME Sink turns any useful part straight into research data, as fast as you can supply it!; Participating employees will be compensated with [Coupon]s to spend at the [AWESOME Shop].

intro: The AWESOME Sink is a special building that produces for use in the AWESOME Shop by destroying items inserted into it, converting them into points based on their value or complexity, which in turn are used to print the aforementioned Coupons. Each successive Coupon requires more points to be printed.

title: Assembler

fields.description: Crafts two parts into another part.; Can be automated by feeding parts into it with a conveyor belt connected to the input. The produced parts can be automatically extracted by connecting a conveyor belt to the output.

intro: The Assembler is a building used to automate the production of two-ingredient parts. It is not capable of alloying ingots, which is done by the Foundry.

title: Beams

fields.name: Metal Beam
fields.description: Snaps to other Beams and various other structural buildings.; Beams support multiple build modes for different use cases.

intro: Metal=

title: Biomass Burner

fields.description: Burns various forms of biomass to generate electricity for the power grid. Now has conveyor input, and can therefore be fed biomass manually and automatically.</br>Resource consumption will automatically be lowered to meet power demands.
fields.fuel: [Leaves], [Flower Petals], [Wood], [Mycelia], [Biomass], [Solid Biofuel], [Packaged Liquid Biofuel], [Hog Remains], [Plasma Spitter Remains], [Stinger Remains], [Hatcher Remains], [Fabric]

intro: The Biomass Burner is a power generator building that generates power by burning various biomass items. These materials can be gathered from trees, shrubs, and most flora and fauna found in the world. Later these raw materials can be refined into Biomass and Solid Biofuel for higher fuel efficiency.

title: Blender

fields.description: The Blender is capable of blending fluids and combining them with solid parts in various processes.; Head Lift: 10 meters.; (Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards).; Contains both Conveyor Belt and Pipe inputs and outputs.

intro: The Blender is a late-game building used for a wide variety of late-game recipes involving both fluids and solid resources.

title: Blueprint Designer

fields.description: The Blueprint Designer is used to create custom factory designs and save them as Blueprints.; Blueprints can be accessed from the Build Menu - Blueprint tab.; Note that buildings can only be placed within the Blueprint Designer if they are fully within the boundary frame.; Designer Dimensions: 32m x 32m x 32m

intro: The Blueprint Designer is a special building used to create and manage Blueprints. There's also a Mk 2 and 3, that offer a larger size, but as of October 2024, the info isn't available on the wiki.

title: Catwalk

fields.name: Catwalk Straight
fields.description: Snaps to foundations and other walkways. Specifically made for humans to walk on.

intro: Catwalks are navigational structures used to make safe and easy paths for the pioneer to get around their factory.

title: Coal Generator

fields.description: Burns Coal to boil Water, the produced steam rotates turbines to generate electricity for the power grid.; Has a Conveyor Belt and Pipe input, so both the Coal and Water supply can be automated.; Caution: Always generates at the set clock speed. Shuts down if fuel requirements are not met.

intro: The Coal Generator is a power generator building that generates power by burning , or and . It is the first fully automated power source the pioneer has access to and also the first source to use a mined resource.

title: Constructor

fields.description: Crafts one part into another part.; Can be automated by feeding parts into it with a conveyor belt connected to the input. The produced parts can be automatically extracted by connecting a conveyor belt to the output.

intro: The Constructor is a building used to automate the production of single-ingredient parts.

title: Conveyor Belt

fields.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.1
fields.description: Transports up to 60 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

fields.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.1
fields.description: Transports up to 60 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

title: Conveyor Lift

fields.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.1
fields.description: Transports up to 60 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

title: Conveyor Merger

fields.description: Merges up to three conveyor belts into one.

intro: The Conveyor Merger is a logistics building that merges up to three input conveyors in sequence and outputs all resources onto the output conveyor.

title: Conveyor Poles

fields.name: Conveyor Pole
fields.description: Can be used as a connection for conveyor belts. The height of the pole can be adjusted. Useful to route conveyor belts in a more controlled manner and over long distances.

intro: Simple=

title: Conveyor Splitter

fields.name: Conveyor Splitter
fields.description: Splits conveyor belts in three. ; Useful to move parts and resources from oversaturated conveyor belts.

intro: The Conveyor Splitter is a logistic structure that takes items from a single input Conveyor Belt or Lift and outputs them between three other belts.

title: Craft Bench

fields.description: Allows you to manually craft a large range of different parts.; These parts can then be used in construction of different factory buildings, vehicles and equipment.

intro: The Craft Bench is a manual crafting station, allowing to craft all unlocked components, except for:

title: Craft Bench/ja

fields.name: Craft Bench
fields.description: 手動で多岐にわたる部品を作成可能。; これらの部品で設備や車両、装備などを作成することができる。

intro: Craft Benchは基本的な手動の工作台です。HUBにはCraft Benchが標準で備わっていますが、建設メニューで好きなところへ建てることができます。装備品以外のほぼすべての部品を作成することができます。装備品はEquipment Workshopを使って作成します。

title: Craft Bench/zh

fields.name: 製作台
fields.description: 可在此手工製作各種不同部件。; 這些部件可使用於建造不同工廠建物、載具和裝備。

intro: 製作台是一個基本的手動加工站。基地有內建一個製作台，但額外的製作台可以在其他地方通過建造選單來建造。

title: Cyber Wagon

fields.description: Absolutely indestructible.; Needs no further introduction.
fields.fuel: [Leaves], [Flower Petals], [Wood], [Mycelia], [Fabric], [Hog Remains], [Plasma Spitter Remains], [Stinger Remains], [Hatcher Remains], [Color Cartridge], [Biomass], [Solid Biofuel], [Packaged Liquid Biofuel], [Coal], [Compacted Coal], [Petroleum Coke], [Packaged Oil], [Packaged Heavy Oil Residue], [Packaged Fuel], [Packaged Turbofuel], [Battery], [Uranium Fuel Rod], [Plutonium Fuel Rod]

intro: The Cyber Wagon is a vehicle, originally jokingly announced shortly after the Tesla Cybertruck was unveiled, that was later introduced into the game after enough positive feedback.

title: Drone

fields.description: Has to be built on a Drone Port.; Transports available input back and forth between its home and destination Port.; Requires Batteries as fuel, based on travel distance. Refuels at any Port, if able.; Drone Status and other details are shown on its home Drone Port.

intro: Drones are aerial vehicles that operate on various different packaged fuels by flying between selected Drone Ports.

title: Drone Port

fields.description: Drone Ports can be assigned one other Port as their transport destination. Each Drone Port can contain a single Drone, which transports available input back and forth between its home and destination Port.; The Drone Port interface provides delivery details and allows management of Port connections.

intro: The Drone Port is a late-game building used for long range, low-throughput item transportation. A Drone can be built on it. Dismantling the Drone Port also removes its nested Drone.

title: Electric Locomotive

fields.description: This locomotive is used to move Freight Cars from station to station.; Requires 25-110 MW of Power to drive.; Must be built on railway.; Named 'Leif' by FICSIT pioneers because of its reliability.

intro: The Electric Locomotive is a vehicle used to transport cargo and pioneers along the Railway. Connected Freight Cars can be loaded or unloaded via Freight Platforms. The Electric Locomotive can be automated, by setting a list of Train Stations for it to stop at.

title: Empty Platform

fields.description: An empty train platform for when you need to create some empty space.

intro: Regular=

title: Equipment Workshop

fields.description: Used to manually craft equipment.

intro: The Equipment Workshop is the station at which engineers can manually craft non-crafting components such as tools, ammunition and consumables.

title: Equipment Workshop/zh

fields.name: 裝備工作坊
fields.description: 可在此手工製作裝備。

intro: 裝備工作坊可以讓工程師手工製作工具、彈藥和消耗品。

title: Explorer

fields.description: Fuel: Any fuel type; 24-slot inventory. Has a built-in craft bench.; Fast and nimble exploration vehicle. Tuned for really rough terrain and able to climb almost vertical surfaces.
fields.fuel: [Leaves], [Flower Petals], [Wood], [Mycelia], [Fabric], [Hog Remains], [Plasma Spitter Remains], [Stinger Remains], [Hatcher Remains], [Color Cartridge], [Biomass], [Solid Biofuel], [Packaged Liquid Biofuel], [Coal], [Compacted Coal], [Petroleum Coke], [Packaged Oil], [Packaged Heavy Oil Residue], [Packaged Fuel], [Packaged Turbofuel], [Battery], [Uranium Fuel Rod], [Plutonium Fuel Rod]

intro: The Explorer is an all-terrain vehicle. It is faster and more agile compared to both Tractor and Truck and has improved drifting capabilities. The explorer grips or "grapples" the terrain, allowing it to climb steep surfaces and handles rough terrain well, though it has a tough time climbing surfaces such as walls. It can knock down small trees and vegetation.

title: FICSMAS

fields.name: FICSMAS Gift
fields.description: Special FICSMAS buildings and parts can be obtained and produced from this FICSIT Holiday present.

intro: FICS⁕MAS was a seasonal holiday-themed in-game event.

title: Fluid Buffer

fields.description: Can contain up to 400m{cubic} of fluid.; Has an in and output for pipes.

intro: Normal=

title: Foundry

fields.description: Smelts two resources into alloy ingots.; Can be automated by feeding ore into it with a conveyor belt connected to the inputs. The produced ingots can be automatically extracted by connecting a conveyor belt to the output.

intro: The Foundry is a building that smelts two ore resources into alloy ingots. It cannot be used for smelting single ore resources into single ingot resources nor does it behave like a Mk.2 Smelter.

title: Freight Car

fields.description: The Freight Car can be built on [Railway]s and attached to an [Electric Locomotive] or other Freight Car to transport resources. Resources are loaded or unloaded at [Freight Platform]s. ; Has a 1600 m{cubic} or 32 slot capacity, depending on the resources.

intro: Freight Cars are non-motorized vehicles that can be attached to Electric Locomotives or another Freight Car to form a train. They have a capacity of 32 item slots or 1,600 m(Main Branch), 2,400m(1.2 Experimental) for fluids and allow for the transportation of resources over Railways. Freight Cars can be loaded and unloaded via Freight Platforms or Fluid Freight Platforms.

title: Freight Platform

fields.description: Freight Cars that stop at the Freight Platform will be loaded or unloaded by the Freight Platform.; Loading and unloading options can be set inside the building.; Snaps to other Platforms and Stations.; Needs to be connected to a powered Railway to function.

intro: Solid=

title: Fuel Generator

fields.description: Consumes Fuel to generate electricity for the power grid.; Has a Pipe input so the Fuel supply can be automated.; Caution: Always generates at the set clock speed. Shuts down if fuel requirements are not met.
fields.powergenerated: 250MW or 625MW if using 3 Power Shards at full output

intro: The Fuel Generator is a power generator building that generates power by burning , or , or Ionized Fuel.

title: Future content/Archive Update 4

fields.name: Blender
fields.description: Making margaritas in Update 4 using this thing. (video description)

intro: This page is an archive of past versions of the current page.

title: Geothermal Generator

fields.description: Has to be built on a Geyser. Generates power.; Caution: Power production fluctuates.; Power Production:; Impure 50-150 MW (100 MW average); Normal 100-300 MW (200 MW average); Pure 200-600 MW (400 MW average)

intro: Geothermal Generator=

title: Hypertube

fields.description: Tubes for transporting FICSIT employees.; A Hypertube Entrance needs to be attached to power and enter a Hypertube system.

intro: The Hypertube is a pipe-like transport system used to quickly transport pioneers over long distances. A Hypertube Entrance is required for entry, but not for an exit. Hypertubes are non-directional and can be entered from both ends if an Entrance is placed on each end.

title: Hypertube Entrance

fields.description: Used to enter and power a Hypertube.

intro: The Hypertube Entrance is a building used to enter the Hypertube. Unlike the Hypertube Support, its height or angle cannot be changed during construction. It can also be attached to a Support if it's at the end of the tube.

title: Hypertube Supports

fields.name: Hypertube Support
fields.description: Supports for Hypertubes to allow for longer distances.

intro: Simple=

title: Indicator Light

fields.description: Attached to most powered buildings.; Displays the operating state of the building.

intro: Indicator Lights are tube lights situated on electricity-powered and generator buildings that reflect the building's operating state. There are four total operating states they can display.

title: Jump Pad

fields.description: Used for quick, vertical traversal.; The launch angle can be adjusted while building.; Caution: Be sure to land safely!

intro: The Jump Pad is a building that can launch pioneers, creatures, and vehicles into the air. After placement (single mouse click), the launch angle can be adjusted from 0° to 90° in 5° steps, and an estimated trajectory and landing spot is shown while setting the angle.

title: Ladder

fields.description: A ladder with a default height of 2 meters, which can be extended while building. Snaps to walls and foundations.

intro: The Ladder is a vertical climbable structure. It can be built free-standing on the ground, on Foundations or on Walls.

title: Lights

fields.name: Lights Control Panel
fields.description: Useful for sectioning and modifying many lights at once.; Controls all Lights connected to the Power Grid attached to the 'Light Power Connector'.; (Other Control Panels and Power Switches interrupt the connection.)

intro: Panel=

title: Lookout Tower

fields.description: Provides a good OVERVIEW useful for building.

intro: The Lookout Tower is an early game organization structure that provides a tall platform for good view for building.

title: MAM

fields.description: The Molecular Analysis Machine is used to analyse new and exotic materials found on alien planets.; R&D will assist Pioneers through the MAM to turn any valuable data into usable research options and new technologies.

intro: The MAM, or "Molecular Analysis Machine", is a building where additional buildings and blueprints are unlocked outside the path of Milestones. Its tech trees are initiated and expanded upon through the discovery of various items in the game, which encourages pioneers to explore around the world.

title: Manufacturer

fields.description: Crafts three or four parts into another part.; Can be automated by feeding parts into it with a conveyor belt connected to the input. The produced parts can be automatically extracted by connecting a conveyor belt to the output.

intro: The Manufacturer is a building used to automate the production of three or four-ingredient items.

title: Miner

fields.name: Miner Mk.1
fields.description: Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on.</br>The normal extraction rate is 60 resources per minute.</br>The extraction rate is modified depending on resource purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected conveyor belts.

intro: Mk.1=

title: Nuclear Power Plant

fields.description: Consumes Nuclear Fuel Rods and Water to produce electricity for the power grid.; Produces Nuclear Waste, which is extracted from the conveyor belt output.; Caution: Always generates at the set clock speed. Shuts down if fuel requirements are not met.

intro: The Nuclear Power Plant is a power generator building that generates power by burning , or Ficsonium Fuel Rods, producing or respectively.

title: Oil Extractor

fields.description: Normal extraction rate: 120m{cubic} oil per minute.; Head Lift: 10 meters. (Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)</br>Can be built on an Oil Node to extract Crude Oil. Extraction rates depend on node purity.

intro: The Oil Extractor is a building used to extract fluid Crude Oil from its resource node. The default extraction rate is 120 , based on normal node purity (see below).

title: Old unreleased content

fields.name: Dark Matter
fields.description: (blank description)

intro: This page lists old unreleased content which was datamined from old builds of the game and will not be implemented into the game, according to an official video by Coffee Stain.

title: Packager

fields.description: Used for the packaging and unpacking of fluids. Head Lift: 10 meters. (Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)</br>Contains both a Conveyor Belt and Pipe input and output, to allow for the automation of various recipes.

intro: The Packager is a building used to package and unpackage fluids in and out of or . Both Canisters and Fluid Tanks are returned when fluid is unpackaged from them, allowing them to be reused. Packaged liquids can be transported with Conveyor Belts - this can be more efficient when transporting them with Conveyor Lifts due to the power usage of Pipeline Pumps, but only for very large vertical distan

title: Particle Accelerator

fields.description: The FICSIT Particle Accelerator uses electromagnetic fields to propel particles to very high speeds and energies. The specific design allows for a variety of processes, such as matter generation and conversion.; Warning: Power usage is extremely high, unstable, and varies per recipe.

intro: The Particle Accelerator is a building used to craft advanced late-game recipes. Unlike other production buildings, its power consumption fluctuates and varies per selected recipe. The least power is consumed at the beginning of a crafting cycle and it increases to the maximum throughout the duration of the crafting cycle.

title: Personal Storage Box

fields.name: Personal Storage Box
fields.description: Contains 25 slots for storing large amounts of items.
fields.researchtier: [Tier 0] - HUB Upgrade 1 (HUB upgrade); [Tier 1] - Field Research (standalone building)

intro: Personal=

title: Pillars

fields.name: Big Pillar Support
fields.description: The Pillar Support snaps to Pillars and can be placed on, for example, Foundations and Walls.
fields.researchtier: [AWESOME Shop] - Metal Pillar Set; [AWESOME Shop] - Concrete Pillar Set; [AWESOME Shop] - Frame Pillar Set

intro: Pillars are a set of decorative buildings.

title: Pipeline

fields.name: Pipeline Mk.1
fields.description: Outside indicators show volume, flow rate and direction.; Transports up to 300 m{cubic} of fluid per minute.; Used to transport fluids.

intro: Mk.1=

title: Pipeline Junction Cross

fields.description: Can be attached to a pipeline to split it 4-way.

intro: The Pipeline Junction Cross allows liquid flow in any direction and can be used to split or merge pipelines four ways. Any configuration works functionally: one input - three outputs, two inputs - two outputs, etc. Flow rates are only limited by the individual pipes entering and exiting.

title: Pipeline Pump

fields.name: Pipeline Pump Mk.1
fields.description: Can be attached to a Pipeline to apply Head Lift.; Maximum Head Lift: 20 meters.; (Allows fluids to be transported 20 meters upwards.); Note: Has an in- and output direction.; Note: Head Lift does not stack, so space between Pumps is recommended.

intro: Mk.1=

title: Pipeline Supports

fields.name: Pipeline Support
fields.description: Can be used as a connection for pipelines. The height of the support can be adjusted. Useful to route pipelines in a more controlled manner and over long distances.

intro: Simple=

title: Power Line

fields.description: Used to connect Power Poles, Power Generators and Factory buildings.

intro: Power Lines are used to connect Power Poles and buildings to provide or draw power. Just like Power Poles, they have no capacity limit and can transmit as much power as provided, losslesly.

title: Power Pole

fields.name: Power Pole Mk.1
fields.description: Can handle up to 4 [Power Line] connections. Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings together with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies the connected buildings with power.

intro: Power Poles are small towers or attachments that can be used to extend the range of Power Lines and to transfer power from buildings that produce power to buildings that consume it. Ground Power Poles can be placed on the regular ground but will also snap to foundations. Wall Power Poles are unlocked through the AWESOME Shop and can be placed on walls or to the bottom of foundations.

title: Power Storage

fields.description: Storage Capacity: 100 MWh (100 MW for 1 hour); Max Charge Rate: 100 MW; Max Discharge Rate: Unlimited; Can be connected to a Power Grid to store excess power production. The stored power can be used later in cases of high consumption.

intro: The Power Storage is a mid-game building used for buffering electrical energy. Each can store up to 100 MWh, or 100 MW for 1 hour. As it allows 2 power connections, multiple Power Storages can be daisy-chained to store large amounts of energy.

title: Power Switch

fields.description: Can be switched ON/OFF to enable/disable the connection between two Power Grids.; Note the location of the A and B connection.;

intro: The Power Switch is a building that can be used to break or connect different power grids, which is useful for controlling the power supply to different parts of a factory.

title: Programmable Splitter

fields.description: Splits conveyor belts in three.; You can set rules for each output to decide exactly where each part should go.

intro: The Programmable Splitter is an upgraded version of the Smart Splitter that allows multiple items to be filtered on each output instead of just one. A maximum of 64 different rules can be set in total for all outputs.

title: Radar Tower

fields.description: Radar Towers scan their surrounding area to display additional information on the Map.; ; The information revealed on the Map includes:; - Resource Node locations; - Terrain data; - Flora & fauna information; - Notable signal readings

intro: The Radar Tower is a building which is used solely for revealing a circular area around itself on the Map.

title: Railway

fields.description: Used to transport [train]s in a reliable and fast manner. Has a wide turn angle so make sure to plan it out properly.
fields.size_note: *12 m tracks can sometimes be placed, but not reliably.

intro: The Railway is a buildable structure which trains run on. Railways connect Train Stations and form a logistic network besides Conveyors, Drones and optional automated wheeled vehicles.

title: Refinery

fields.description: Refines fluid and/or solid parts into other parts.; Head Lift: 10 meters.; (Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.); Contains both a Conveyor Belt and Pipe input and output, to allow for the automation of various recipes.

intro: The Refinery is a building used for crafting recipes involving fluids. Most notably, this includes recipes transforming into , , or , but it is also used as part of advanced production recipes, such as refining into and then further into . It has one Pipeline and one Conveyor Belt connectors for both input and output, allowing for the production and consumption of recipes involving fluids and/or s

title: Resource Well Pressurizer

fields.name: Resource Well Pressurizer
fields.description: Can be placed on a Resource Well to activate it by pressurizing the underground resource.</br>Once activated, Resource Well Extractors can be placed on the surrounding sub-nodes to extract the resource.</br>Requires Power. Overclocking increases the output potential of the entire Resource Well.

intro: Pressurizer=

title: Roofs

fields.name: FICSIT Roof 4m
fields.description: Snaps to Foundations, Walls, and other Roofs.; Size: 8m × 4m

intro: Roofs are a set of buildings which can be used to cover open areas of a factory. They can be painted, like other buildings. Roofs snap to other Walls. They are useful for decorating structures.

title: Signs

fields.name: Signs
fields.description: Signs can be customized with different elements, such as icons and text, to improve factory organization.; Can be placed freely, on Walls, or attached to a variety of buildings, such as Storage Containers.

intro: Signs are organizational structures that can be placed freely or attached to most structural and factory buildings, such as Walls, Foundations, Storage Containers, Truck Stations etc.

title: Smart Splitter

fields.description: Splits conveyor belts in three.; You can set a rule for each output to decide exactly what part should go there.

intro: The Smart Splitter is an upgraded version of the Splitter capable of filtering its input and handling overflow.

title: Smelter

fields.description: Smelts ore into ingots.; Can be automated by feeding ore into it with a conveyor belt connected to the input. The produced ingots can be automatically extracted by connecting a conveyor belt to the output.

intro: The Smelter is a building used to smelt raw ores into ingots.

title: Space Elevator

fields.description: Requires deliveries of special Project Parts to complete Phases of Project Assembly. Completing Phases in the Space Elevator will unlock new Tiers in the HUB Terminal.

intro: The Space Elevator is a special building used to complete phases of Project Assembly by supplying it with Project Assembly Parts. The first three deliveries unlock two higher Tiers of Milestones, while the fourth one unlocks the 'Employee of the Planet' Cup in the AWESOME Shop.

title: Space Elevator/zh

fields.name: 太空電梯
fields.description: 需要藉由發送特殊計畫組件來完成組裝計畫的不通階段。完成太空電梯階段將會在基地終端機內解鎖新的層級。

intro: 太空電梯是完成遊戲最終目標："組裝計畫"用的大型建築。玩家必須建造它，並用其將資源發送到軌道。每次交付可解鎖2個更高的里程碑等級。

title: Storage Container

fields.description: Contains 24 slots for storing large amounts of items. Has an input and output for conveyor belts.

intro: Normal=

title: The HUB

fields.description: The heart of your factory. This is where you complete FICSIT milestones to unlock additional blueprints of buildings, vehicles, parts, equipment etc.

intro: The HUB, or "Habitat and Utility Base", is the heart of the factory and the first build-able structure in-game. Initially only containing a Craft Bench and the HUB Terminal, it can be upgraded as the pioneer progresses along the Milestones in Tier 0. The completed HUB, in addition, contains two small Biomass Burners, a FICSIT Freighter, and living quarters, also functioning as the pioneers' respaw

title: Tractor

fields.description: Fuel: Any fuel type. 25 slot inventory. Has a built in Craft Bench. Can be automated to pick up and deliver resources at Truck Stations. Nicknamed the Sugarcube by FICSIT pioneers.

intro: The Tractor (aka "The Sugar-Cube"<ref name="yt-IxoCzb2M0vQ@70">YouTube - Coffee Stain - Dev Blog #1: Vehicles (70 s)</ref>) is a small, wheeled vehicle which can be either driven by the pioneer or automated. It is an early game vehicle and the first (off-road) vehicle the pioneer has access to.<ref name="yt-IxoCzb2M0vQ@90">YouTube - Coffee Stain - Dev Blog #1: Vehicles (90 s)</ref> It can destroy

title: Train Signals

fields.name: Block Signal
fields.description: Train Signals are used to direct the movement of Trains to avoid collisions and bottlenecks.; Block Signals can be placed on Railways to create 'Blocks' between each other. When a Train is occupying such a Block, other Trains will be unable to enter it.; Caution: Signals are directional! Trains are unable to move against this direction, so be sure to set up Signals in both directions for bi-directional Railways.

intro: This wiki is deprecated since update 7, Please use new official wiki at https://satisfactory.wiki.gg/wiki/ (official Satisfactory wiki) Find up to date Turbo fuel info at https://satisfactory.wiki.gg/wiki/Turbofuel

title: Train Station

fields.description: [Electric Locomotive|Locomotives] can be set to drive and stop at the train station.; You can connect [power] to the train station to power up the train on the [railway] as well as transport power to the other stations.

intro: A Train Station is a building on the Railway where trains can be instructed to stop. Each station can be renamed in its UI.

title: Truck

fields.description: Fuel: Any fuel type. 48 slot inventory. Has a built in Craft Bench. Can be automated to pick up and deliver resources at Truck Stations. Nicknamed 'the Unit' by FICSIT pioneers because of its massive frame.
fields.fuel: [Leaves], [Flower Petals], [Wood], [Mycelia], [Fabric], [Hog Remains], [Plasma Spitter Remains], [Stinger Remains], [Hatcher Remains], [Color Cartridge], [Biomass], [Solid Biofuel], [Packaged Liquid Biofuel], [Coal], [Compacted Coal], [Petroleum Coke], [Packaged Oil], [Packaged Heavy Oil Residue], [Packaged Fuel], [Packaged Turbofuel], [Battery], [Uranium Fuel Rod], [Plutonium Fuel Rod]

intro: The Truck (aka "The Unit") is a 6-wheeled vehicle which can be used to transport large amounts of cargo on land. It can be either driven by the pioneer or automated. It has a higher maximum speed and twice the storage capacity compared to the Tractor, and can ford deeper water without getting stuck. title: Truck Station

fields.description: Either send or receive resources to vehicles.; Has an inventory with 48 slots.; Transfers up to 120 stacks per minute to/from docked vehicle.; Always refuels vehicles if it has access to a matching fuel type.

intro: The Truck Station is a vehicle building used to automatically move cargo to/from motor vehicles and refuel them. It is mostly used to set-up automated vehicle routes, although it can operate standalone, such as for the purposes of quick refueling.

title: U-Jelly Landing Pad

fields.description: Generates a speed dampening jelly. Guarantees a soft landing.

intro: The U-Jelly Landing Pad is a building that, when powered, generates a viscous green jelly cylinder that significantly slows movement while immersed. Landing onto the jelly part of the Landing Pad will prevent pioneers from taking fall damage.

title: Valve

fields.description: Used to limit Pipeline flow rates. Can be attached to a Pipeline.</br>NOTE: Has an in- and output direction.

intro: The Valve is a building that attaches to Pipelines. Its primary purpose is to limit the flow rate and prevent backflow.

title: Walkway

fields.name: Walkway Straight
fields.description: Snaps to foundations and other walkways. Specifically made for humans to walk on.

intro: Walkways are navigational structures used to make safe and easy paths for the pioneer to get around their factory. They are relatively cheap compared to Foundations, however, for bridge structures involving logistic buildings such as Belts, Pipelines or Rails then Foundations and Ramps are recommended.

title: Water Extractor

fields.description: Default extraction rate: 120m{cubic} water per minute.; Head Lift: 10 meters.; (Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.); Extracts water from the body of water it is built on.; Note that the water needs to be deep enough and that rivers do not commonly suffice.

intro: The Water Extractor is a Building used to pump Water out of water bodies. It has one Pipeline output with a recommended head lift of 10 meters.
